Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.body: wstGBP is a non-rebasing ERC-20 wrapper around tGBP, the sterling stablecoin issued by FCA-registered BCP Technologies. A commercial agreement between BCP and Wren Spire passes part of the income from tGBP's reserves (UK gilts, sterling cash and money market funds) to the wrapper. That income lands as periodic NAV updates to the wstGBP/tGBP rate, which is in GBP, not USD.
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.backing: tGBP (sterling cash, UK gilts, money market funds)
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.yieldSource: share of tGBP reserve interest paid to Wren under a commercial agreement with BCP
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.redemption: permissionless mint; instant on-chain redeem to tGBP at NAV less a 25 bps fee, no cooldown
Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.issuer: Wren Spire (BVI) Ltd, an Arb Capital company

Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.what: Strata senior tranche of sUSDe · Aave-rate floor, junior first-loss cover, sUSDe upside
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.body: srUSDe is the senior (protected) tranche of Strata's Ethena market: an ERC-4626 token whose exchange rate to USDe only rises. The pooled USDe is staked as sUSDe, which earns Ethena's perp funding/basis carry plus staking yield; srUSDe takes a share of that with a floor at the supply-weighted Aave v3 Core USDC/USDT lending rate, paying a risk premium to jrUSDe. jrUSDe is first-loss capital, so srUSDe only loses principal if the junior tranche is wiped out.
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.backing: USDe staked as sUSDe, over-collateralized by the jrUSDe first-loss tranche
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.yieldSource: sUSDe yield (perp funding + basis carry + staked-ETH), floored at the Aave USDC/USDT supply rate
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.redemption: permissionless; instant redeem to sUSDe or USDe after Ethena's 7-day cooldown; 2.5 bps fee; mint paused if coverage < 105%

Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.what: Strata junior tranche of sUSDe · levered residual sUSDe yield, first-loss cover for senior
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.body: jrUSDe is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's Ethena market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sUSDe. It gets the sUSDe yield (Ethena funding/basis carry) left after srUSDe is paid its floor, plus the senior's risk premium, so it beats sUSDe when funding is high. When sUSDe yield falls below the Aave benchmark, or on an Ethena loss, jrUSDe pays the shortfall, so its exchange rate can fall and principal can be lost.
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.backing: USDe staked as sUSDe; subordinated to srUSDe
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.yieldSource: residual sUSDe yield (perp funding + basis) after paying senior, plus senior risk premium
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.redemption: instant redeem to sUSDe or USDe after 7-day Ethena cooldown; 10 bps fee; redemptions paused if senior coverage < 105%

Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.what: Strata senior tranche of Neutrl sNUSD · impaired with NUSD (~$0.63/share), deposits shut
Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.body: srNUSD is the senior tranche of Strata's Neutrl market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled NUSD staked as sNUSD, junior-protected. Neutrl's August 2026 reserve impairment cut NUSD to a 0.51 USDC recovery rate; that loss exceeded jrNUSD's cover, which went to ~0, and the senior took the rest. On 2026-10-17 one srNUSD converted to 1.2397 NUSD, about $0.63 at the portal rate, Strata's own feed marks it 0.632 and both tranches read maxDeposit = 0.

Its price in HYPE moves with those strategies and can fall: over 30 days to mid-October 2026 it read -9.3 % annualized, after +3.7 % over the prior 7 days.
Hyperwave HYPE::hwHYPE.backing: HYPE and HYPE derivatives deployed in HyperEVM DeFi
Hyperwave HYPE::hwHYPE.yieldSource: returns of the deployed HYPE strategies (can be negative)
Hyperwave HYPE::hwHYPE.verify: Strategy composition and exit terms were not checked; 30-day return was negative.

WSUPEROETHB.what: Origin wrapped Super OETH (Base) · ETH yield from staking and an Aerodrome AMO
WSUPEROETHB.body: wsuperOETHb is the non-rebasing ERC-4626 wrapper of Origin's Super OETH on Base, an ETH token whose yield comes from staked ETH and Origin's liquidity strategy on Aerodrome. Wrapping turns superOETHb's rebases into a rising share price (about 2.8 % APR on ~1,345 superOETHb in October 2026).
WSUPEROETHB.backing: superOETHb (ETH, staked ETH and Aerodrome AMO positions)
WSUPEROETHB.yieldSource: ETH staking yield plus Aerodrome AMO fees and rewards
WSUPEROETHB.redemption: instant unwrap to superOETHb; superOETHb exits through Origin's withdrawal flow or Aerodrome

Plasma USD Vault::PlasmaUSD.what: Veda Plasma USD Vault · USDT0 savings vault on Plasma, mostly Aave lending
Plasma USD Vault::PlasmaUSD.body: PlasmaUSD is a Veda BoringVault on Plasma that started as Plasma's pre-deposit vault and stayed on as a USDT0 savings product, lending mainly on Aave. Veda's accountant sets the share price (about 1.04, 4.1 % APR and $30.6M in October 2026).
Plasma USD Vault::PlasmaUSD.backing: USDT0 deployed mostly into Aave on Plasma
Plasma USD Vault::PlasmaUSD.redemption: Veda withdrawal queue (request, then solver payout)

Shadow Liquid Staking Token::X33.what: Shadow x33 · liquid xSHADOW on Sonic, compounds DEX fees and vote rewards
Shadow Liquid Staking Token::X33.body: x33 is Shadow Exchange's liquid wrapper of xSHADOW, the non-transferable staked SHADOW that votes in Shadow's ve(3,3) DEX on Sonic. The wrapper votes and reinvests the fees, incentives and rebases into more xSHADOW, so x33's rate rises (about 26 % APR in xSHADOW in October 2026). The yield and the principal are both in SHADOW, a governance token, so dollar value moves with its price.
Shadow Liquid Staking Token::X33.yieldSource: Shadow DEX fees, vote incentives and rebases, compounded in xSHADOW
Shadow Liquid Staking Token::X33.redemption: trade on Shadow pools (thin); unwrapping to xSHADOW keeps the non-transferable lock

Harmonix kHYPE::HAKHYPE.what: Harmonix kHYPE vault · ERC-4626 over Kinetiq kHYPE, earns in HYPE
Harmonix kHYPE::HAKHYPE.body: hakHYPE is a Harmonix Finance ERC-4626 vault over kHYPE, Kinetiq's staked HYPE. Measured in HYPE it earned about 2.2 % APR in October 2026, which includes kHYPE's own staking yield; it held about 59.7k kHYPE.
Harmonix kHYPE::HAKHYPE.yieldSource: kHYPE staking yield plus Harmonix strategy returns
Harmonix kHYPE::HAKHYPE.redemption: through Harmonix (request-based exits on its other vaults); not checked here
Harmonix kHYPE::HAKHYPE.verify: Strategy, admin keys and exit terms were not checked.

Looped Hype::LHYPE.what: Looped HYPE · automated stHYPE/HYPE leverage loop on HyperEVM lending markets
Looped Hype::LHYPE.body: LHYPE is the receipt token of loopedHYPE, an automated leverage strategy: deposited HYPE is staked into stHYPE, which is posted as collateral to borrow more HYPE on HyperEVM lending markets, repeatedly. It earns staking yield times leverage minus HYPE borrow cost (about 1.3 % APR on $6.5M in October 2026) and loses when borrow rates exceed staking yield.
Looped Hype::LHYPE.backing: leveraged stHYPE position against HYPE debt
Looped Hype::LHYPE.yieldSource: leveraged HYPE staking yield minus borrow cost
Looped Hype::LHYPE.redemption: time-bound withdrawal requests paid in stHYPE, with a fee; or a DEX sale
Looped Hype::LHYPE.verify: Operator identity and current exit terms were not checked against official docs.

xHYPE::XHYPE.what: Liminal xHYPE · delta-neutral HYPE (spot/LST long + perp short), earns funding
xHYPE::XHYPE.body: xHYPE is one of Liminal's delta-neutral 'xTokens' on Hyperliquid: it holds HYPE (partly as liquid staking tokens) and shorts an equal amount of HYPE perps, so it earns perp funding plus staking yield with little HYPE price exposure. About 8.9 % APR on $8.5M in October 2026; Liminal takes 10 % of funding gains. Negative funding lowers the value.
xHYPE::XHYPE.backing: spot HYPE/LSTs hedged with HYPE perp shorts on Hyperliquid
xHYPE::XHYPE.yieldSource: HYPE perp funding plus staking yield, minus a 10 % performance fee
xHYPE::XHYPE.redemption: through Liminal (instant buffer or queued, as for limUSD)
xHYPE::XHYPE.verify: xHYPE contract and exit terms were not checked.

limUSD::LIMUSD.what: Liminal limUSD · allocator over delta-neutral Hyperliquid funding and lending xTokens
limUSD::LIMUSD.body: limUSD is Liminal's USD allocator on HyperEVM (LayerZero copies on Ethereum and Arbitrum). It spreads deposits over Liminal's xTokens: delta-neutral HYPE and BTC carry positions on Hyperliquid that earn perp funding and staking yield, and a lending sleeve. Its price is not computed on-chain: Liminal posts the NAV (bounded per update), and price per share = NAV / supply (1.0362 USDC on 2026-10-16, about 8 % APR on $8.9M). Liminal takes 10 % of performance on top of the xTokens' own fees.
limUSD::LIMUSD.backing: USDC and Hyperliquid spot/perp positions held by Liminal's strategist
limUSD::LIMUSD.yieldSource: perp funding, staking and money-market yield of the xTokens
limUSD::LIMUSD.redemption: instant from a buffer at a 0.3 % fee (capped by the strategist's USDC, ~$374k in Oct 2026), or a free queued request paid automatically within ~3 days
limUSD::LIMUSD.verify: NAV is posted by Liminal with no attestation; the instant buffer is held by an EOA.

Staked HYPE::STHYPE.what: Valantis stHYPE · rebasing staked HYPE, the same ledger as wstHYPE
Staked HYPE::STHYPE.body: stHYPE is the rebasing balance token of Valantis's (formerly Thunderhead) HYPE liquid staking: HYPE is delegated to HyperCore validators and holders' balances grow with staking rewards (about 1.5 % APR in October 2026). It is a view of the same accounting as wstHYPE, the non-rebasing wrapper, about 1.036 HYPE per wstHYPE share, so the two are one $175M book. Upgrades sit behind a 48 h timelock and a 4-of-6 Safe.
Staked HYPE::STHYPE.redemption: unstake through Valantis (HyperCore unbonding) or trade

haHYPE::haHYPE.what: Harmonix haHYPE · HYPE strategy vault across Felix, HyperLend, Kinetiq and Pendle
haHYPE::haHYPE.body: haHYPE is a Harmonix Finance ERC-4626 vault over WHYPE. Harmonix deploys the HYPE across Hyperliquid and HyperEVM protocols (Felix, HyperLend, Kinetiq, Pendle) at its discretion, so the share price in HYPE rises with those returns (1.0475 HYPE, about 2.2 % APR on ~16k HYPE in October 2026). Its admin and role holders could not be identified on-chain.
haHYPE::haHYPE.backing: WHYPE deployed across HyperEVM lending, staking and Pendle positions
haHYPE::haHYPE.yieldSource: HYPE lending, staking and Pendle returns, managed by Harmonix
haHYPE::haHYPE.redemption: initiateWithdrawal locks shares at the current price; once Harmonix funds it, redeem to WHYPE
haHYPE::haHYPE.verify: Small discretionary vault; keyholders and strategy limits not verified.

Kinetiq Earn Vault::vkHYPE.what: Kinetiq Earn vkHYPE · Veda vault deploying kHYPE and HYPE across HyperEVM DeFi
Kinetiq Earn Vault::vkHYPE.body: vkHYPE is Kinetiq Earn, a Veda BoringVault on HyperEVM curated by Seven Seas: it takes kHYPE or HYPE and deploys it across HyperEVM DeFi. Its HYPE price is an accountant mark bounded to ±1 % per update, and it can fall (1.0365 → 1.0343 between 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-01); over 90 days it grew about 1.1 % APR, less than kHYPE itself (~2 %). 20 % performance fee; about 472k HYPE ($37M).
Kinetiq Earn Vault::vkHYPE.backing: kHYPE and HYPE deployed in HyperEVM DeFi strategies
Kinetiq Earn Vault::vkHYPE.yieldSource: kHYPE staking plus DeFi strategy returns, net of a 20 % performance fee
Kinetiq Earn Vault::vkHYPE.redemption: shares locked 1 day after deposit; then an on-chain queue request (1-10 bps discount) paid in kHYPE by a solver after ~1 hour; cancellable
Kinetiq Earn Vault::vkHYPE.verify: An untimelocked 4-of-6 Safe can widen the strategy set; the rate is a mark that can fall.

Staked KAITO::sKAITO.what: Kaito staked KAITO · KAITO reward distributions, 7-day cooldown
Staked KAITO::sKAITO.body: sKAITO is Kaito's official staking vault on Base, an immutable ERC-4626 over the KAITO token built like Ethena's sUSDe. Kaito pays about 250k KAITO a month into it, vesting over 30 days, so sKAITO rises against KAITO (about 11.4 % APR in KAITO over 90 days, October 2026). Both yield and principal are KAITO, so the dollar value moves with KAITO's price. A 2-of-3 Safe can blacklist holders and move a blacklisted holder's balance.
Staked KAITO::sKAITO.redemption: cooldownShares, wait 7 days, then claim KAITO from the escrow

Super Jarvis Synthetic Euro::sjEUR.what: Jarvis staked jEUR (Base) · euro-denominated, paid by a Superfluid stream
Super Jarvis Synthetic Euro::sjEUR.body: sjEUR is an immutable ERC-4626 on Base over jEURx, a Superfluid wrapper of jEUR, Jarvis Network's euro synthetic. Its yield is a constant Superfluid stream of jEURx from a Jarvis wallet into the vault, a discretionary subsidy: about 4.7 % APR in October 2026, and 0 whenever the stream is closed (it has been closed and reopened 8+ times since Dec 2024). Rate and value are in euros, so a dollar holder carries EUR/USD risk. Jarvis is near-dormant and jEUR traded about 0.5 % below EURC.
Super Jarvis Synthetic Euro::sjEUR.backing: jEUR (Jarvis euro synthetic, via the jEURx wrapper)
Super Jarvis Synthetic Euro::sjEUR.yieldSource: a discretionary Jarvis jEURx stream into the vault
Super Jarvis Synthetic Euro::sjEUR.redemption: instant wrappedRedeem to jEUR, any receiver, no fee
Super Jarvis Synthetic Euro::sjEUR.verify: Euro-denominated; jEUR's backing on Base was not verified; a forwarder set in Jarvis's Finder can act for holders.

Staked USDu::sUSDu.what: Unitas staked USDu · JLP fees plus perp hedge, 7-day cooldown
Staked USDu::sUSDu.body: sUSDu is the staking vault over Unitas's USDu on BNB Chain, a clone of Ethena's sUSDe. USDu is a synthetic dollar whose collateral sits in Jupiter's JLP pool hedged with perp shorts, earning JLP fees and funding; staked returns vest into sUSDu over 8 hours, about 11 % APR on $36.8M in October 2026. Staking is permissionless, while USDu mint and redeem are for whitelisted institutions. A 3-of-5 Safe with no timelock holds blacklist powers.
Staked USDu::sUSDu.backing: USDu (JLP position hedged with perp shorts)
Staked USDu::sUSDu.yieldSource: JLP trading fees and perp funding
Staked USDu::sUSDu.redemption: cooldownShares, wait 7 days, unstake to USDu
Staked USDu::sUSDu.verify: Custody of the hedge positions is not verified.

Unitas Gold::XGLD.what: Unitas Gold · XAUt on Bybit backing delta-neutral USDT strategies, priced in gold
Unitas Gold::XGLD.body: XGLD is Unitas's gold yield token on BNB Chain. Tether Gold (XAUt) is held as collateral on Bybit (off-exchange settlement), USDT is borrowed against it and run in delta-neutral strategies, and the returns raise XGLD's on-chain exchange rate in XAUt (1.0102 XAUt per XGLD, about 3.35 % a year in gold, October 2026). Rate updates are capped at +5 bps each behind a 2-day timelock. The Base copy holds only dust.
Unitas Gold::XGLD.backing: XAUt held on Bybit, plus delta-neutral USDT positions
Unitas Gold::XGLD.yieldSource: returns of delta-neutral strategies funded by borrowing against the gold
Unitas Gold::XGLD.redemption: mint and 7-day redemption only for whitelisted users; others trade PancakeSwap XAUt/XGLD (~$330k), 0.6-1.6 % below NAV
Unitas Gold::XGLD.verify: Exchange custody (Bybit) and the strategies are off-chain and not verified.

Sceptre Staked FLR::SFLR.what: Sceptre sFLR · liquid-staked FLR, P-chain staking rewards, 14.5-day unlock
Sceptre Staked FLR::SFLR.body: sFLR is Sceptre's liquid staking token on Flare (a BENQI sAVAX fork). Deposited FLR is moved by operator keys to stake on Flare's P-chain, and rewards are pushed back about every 3 days after Sceptre's 10 % cut, so the FLR value per sFLR (1.8913 on 2026-10-16) rises in steps: about 7.4 % APR over 30 days, while shorter windows mislead. One EOA owns the upgrade key and admin role with no timelock, and 34 operator EOAs move the staked FLR, so solvency is not provable on-chain.
Sceptre Staked FLR::SFLR.backing: FLR staked on the P-chain by Sceptre operators, plus an instant-redeem WFLR buffer
Sceptre Staked FLR::SFLR.yieldSource: Flare P-chain staking rewards, net of a 10 % protocol share
Sceptre Staked FLR::SFLR.redemption: instant redeem to WFLR at a 0.5 % fee (capped by the buffer, ~40.5M WFLR), or free unlock request: 14.5 days, then a 2-day window to claim WFLR (a missed window returns the shares)
Sceptre Staked FLR::SFLR.verify: Single-EOA upgrade and admin key; staked FLR held by operator keys.

Spectra ERC4626 Wrapper: Staked FLR Flar.what: Spectra wrapper of Sceptre sFLR · 1:1, the yield token behind Spectra's sFLR PTs
Spectra ERC4626 Wrapper: Staked FLR Flar.body: sw-sFLR is Spectra's ERC-4626 wrapper that turns Sceptre sFLR into the interest-bearing token of Spectra's PT/YT markets on Flare. It holds exactly one sFLR per share (68.1M on 2026-10-16) and carries sFLR's rate, about 1.891 WFLR per share and ~7.4 % APR. It adds Spectra's contract risk (upgradeable, 3-of-5 Safe) on top of sFLR's.
Spectra ERC4626 Wrapper: Staked FLR Flar.redemption: unwrap to sFLR, then Sceptre's instant (0.5 % fee) or 14.5-day exit

Firelight stXRP::stXRP.what: Firelight stXRP · FXRP staked as slashable cover capital for DeFi insurance
Firelight stXRP::stXRP.body: stXRP is Firelight's ERC-4626 vault on Flare over FXRP (XRP bridged from the XRP Ledger). Since the cover protocol went live on 6 October 2026, staked FXRP backs insurance cover sold in 30-day periods: premiums raise the share price, and a validated claim that exhausts the first-loss buffer is slashed pro rata from every staker, including pending withdrawals. Premiums began landing on 7 October in steps, so a 7-day window read about 2.7 % APR while a 30-day one (e.g. Spectra's 0.85 %) still averaged in the weeks before. About 42.8M FXRP, down from 60M in July.
Firelight stXRP::stXRP.backing: FXRP (agent-collateralized XRP bridge), at risk to insurance claims
Firelight stXRP::stXRP.redemption: request, then withdraw one full 30-day period later (30-60 days) and claim manually
Firelight stXRP::stXRP.verify: Principal can be slashed by insurance claims; first-loss buffer size and active cover volume were not verified.

Autocompounding vKAT::avKAT.what: Katana avKAT · autocompounding vote-escrowed KAT, 60-day exit up to 25 % fee
Autocompounding vKAT::avKAT.body: avKAT is an Aragon ve-governance autocompounder on Katana: it holds one large vKAT lock and claims KAT voting rewards through Merkl, relocking them, so avKAT rises against KAT (1.374 KAT, about 35 % APR in KAT over 30 days, October 2026). Both yield and principal are KAT emissions and KAT's price, so dollar value moves with KAT (~$0.004). Redeeming does not pay KAT: it splits off a vKAT lock NFT that must go through the escrow's 60-day exit queue with a fee from 25 % falling to 2.5 %, so the practical exit is selling avKAT.
Autocompounding vKAT::avKAT.yieldSource: KAT voting rewards (emissions) claimed via Merkl and relocked
Autocompounding vKAT::avKAT.redemption: redeem to a vKAT lock NFT, then a 60-day escrow exit with a 2.5-25 % fee; or sell avKAT on a DEX
Autocompounding vKAT::avKAT.verify: Principal is a governance-token price; the stack is upgradeable behind a 3-of-7 multisig with no timelock.

Solstice stSLX::stSLX::solana.what: Solstice stSLX · SLX governance token in a GLAM vault, earns SLX emissions
Solstice stSLX::stSLX::solana.body: stSLX is a GLAM single-asset vault over SLX, Solstice's governance token. Solstice's treasury streams SLX into it hourly through a keeper, so stSLX rises against SLX (1.0559 SLX per share on 2026-10-16, about 12.8 % APR in SLX over 30 days). Cycle 1 (Sept-Dec 2026) targets 20 % minus eUSX's 7-day APY, set by a multisig, and the stream paused for at least four days from 12 October. This is an emission of the same volatile token, not revenue, and it does not share USX's backing.
Solstice stSLX::stSLX::solana.backing: SLX held in the GLAM vault
Solstice stSLX::stSLX::solana.yieldSource: SLX emissions streamed from the Solstice treasury
Solstice stSLX::stSLX::solana.redemption: queued redeem with a hard 7-day notice, then anyone can fulfil and the holder claims SLX at that day's NAV; cancel allowed before fulfilment
Solstice stSLX::stSLX::solana.verify: Principal and yield are SLX; the vault owner is a single key and the stream is keeper-driven.

sUSD.infra::sUSD.infra::solana.what: DAWN sUSD.infra · Loopscale credit vault lending USD.infra to DAWN infrastructure deals
sUSD.infra::sUSD.infra::solana.body: sUSD.infra is the share token of a Loopscale lending vault over USD.infra, curated by Dawn Internet (DAWN), whose single borrower is DAWN's telecom and AI-infrastructure deals. In October 2026 it held $9.6M, 87 % idle, with 16 fixed-rate loans at 15-20 % against 27 unlisted collateral tokens marked by DAWN's own service. Its ~5.8 % APR is 2.26 % net interest plus a 3.56 % DAWN-funded stream paid in USD.infra into the share price, scheduled to end 2026-10-23.
sUSD.infra::sUSD.infra::solana.backing: USD.infra, partly lent to DAWN's infrastructure deals
sUSD.infra::sUSD.infra::solana.yieldSource: interest from DAWN infrastructure loans plus a time-boxed DAWN-funded USD.infra stream
sUSD.infra::sUSD.infra::solana.redemption: instant up to idle liquidity in the vault, otherwise queued; Loopscale can pause
sUSD.infra::sUSD.infra::solana.verify: Single borrower with collateral marked off-chain; the 3.56 % stream ends 2026-10-23 unless renewed.

USD.infra::USD.infra::solana.what: DAWN USD.infra · M0 wrapped-M stablecoin on Solana, backed by M0's T-bill dollar
USD.infra::USD.infra::solana.body: USD.infra is DAWN's branded M0 extension stablecoin on Solana: its supply moves only by wrapping and unwrapping M0's $M, which is backed by US Treasury bills, so DAWN cannot mint at will. DAWN's Squads multisig holds freeze and global-pause authority over every holder. Most of it sits in the sUSD.infra lending vault; supply was about 14M in October 2026. Plain USD.infra earns nothing for holders.
USD.infra::USD.infra::solana.redemption: unwrap to $M through M0's swap facility (whether that is open to anyone was not verified), or trade
USD.infra::USD.infra::solana.verify: DAWN can pause or freeze any holder; permissionless wrap/unwrap not verified.

Fragmetric Restaked SOL::fragSOL::solana.what: Fragmetric fragSOL · restaked SOL via Jito Restaking vaults, Token-2022
Fragmetric Restaked SOL::fragSOL::solana.body: fragSOL is Fragmetric's liquid restaking token: SOL and SOL LSTs are staked and restaked through Jito Restaking vaults, and fragSOL's value rises against SOL (1.1422 SOL per fragSOL on 2026-10-16, about 4.8 % APR). Fragmetric takes a 4 % performance fee. It is a Token-2022 mint with a transfer hook, so many venues use the 1:1 SPL wrapper wfragSOL instead. The book was about $4.9M, down roughly 99 % from its mid-2025 peak.
Fragmetric Restaked SOL::fragSOL::solana.backing: SOL and SOL LSTs staked and restaked via Jito Restaking
Fragmetric Restaked SOL::fragSOL::solana.yieldSource: SOL staking plus Jito Restaking (NCN) rewards, net of a 4 % fee
Fragmetric Restaked SOL::fragSOL::solana.redemption: withdrawal request processed in batches, claimable after about 3 epochs (up to ~6 days), 20 bps fee
Fragmetric Restaked SOL::fragSOL::solana.verify: No audit found; liquidity is thin after a ~99 % drop in TVL.

Wrapped Fragmetric Restaked SOL::wfragSO.what: Fragmetric wfragSOL · 1:1 SPL wrapper of fragSOL (restaked SOL)
Wrapped Fragmetric Restaked SOL::wfragSO.body: wfragSOL is the plain SPL-token wrapper of Fragmetric's fragSOL, for venues that cannot hold Token-2022 tokens; one wfragSOL is one fragSOL (1.1422 SOL on 2026-10-16) and carries its ~4.8 % restaking yield. About 19.6k fragSOL was wrapped (~$2.3M), most of the protocol.
Wrapped Fragmetric Restaked SOL::wfragSO.yieldSource: fragSOL's SOL staking plus Jito Restaking rewards
Wrapped Fragmetric Restaked SOL::wfragSO.redemption: unwrap to fragSOL, then Fragmetric's batched withdrawal (up to ~6 days, 20 bps); or trade thin DEX pools
Wrapped Fragmetric Restaked SOL::wfragSO.verify: No audit found; DEX liquidity is thin.

Binance Staked SOL::BNSOL::solana.what: Binance liquid-staked SOL · SPL stake pool over five validators
Binance Staked SOL::BNSOL::solana.body: BNSOL is Binance's liquid staking token on the SPL Stake Pool program: SOL deposited into the pool is staked to five validators (one holds about 80 %) and BNSOL rises against SOL (1.1364 SOL per BNSOL on 2026-10-18, about 4.5 % APR after Binance's 10 % fee on rewards). With about 10.5M SOL it is one of the largest Solana LSTs. Anyone can mint it from SOL on chain at the pool rate with no fee.
Binance Staked SOL::BNSOL::solana.backing: SOL in the stake pool, delegated to five validators chosen by Binance
Binance Staked SOL::BNSOL::solana.yieldSource: SOL staking rewards, net of a 10 % fee on rewards
Binance Staked SOL::BNSOL::solana.redemption: On chain the pool's instant SOL withdrawal needs Binance's signature, so holders unstake into a stake account (0.1 % fee, about one epoch to deactivate) or sell; Binance users can also redeem in their Binance account

Jito Staked SOL::JitoSOL.what: Jito liquid-staked SOL · SPL stake pool with MEV rewards
Jito Staked SOL::JitoSOL.body: JitoSOL is Jito's liquid staking token on the SPL Stake Pool program: deposited SOL is spread over about 670 validators chosen by StakeNet's on-chain rules, and staking plus MEV tip rewards raise JitoSOL against SOL (1.3070 SOL per JitoSOL on 2026-10-18, about 4.7 % APR after Jito's 4 % fee). It holds about 10.5M SOL. On chains other than Solana the token is a bridged representation of the Solana JitoSOL.
Jito Staked SOL::JitoSOL.backing: SOL in the stake pool, delegated across ~670 validators
Jito Staked SOL::JitoSOL.yieldSource: SOL staking rewards plus Jito MEV tips, net of a 4 % fee
Jito Staked SOL::JitoSOL.redemption: instant SOL from the pool reserve (0.1 % fee, capped by the reserve), or unstake into a stake account (0.1 %, about one epoch), or sell

BlazeStake Staked SOL (bSOL)::bSOL::sola.what: BlazeStake liquid-staked SOL · SPL stake pool over ~680 validators
BlazeStake Staked SOL (bSOL)::bSOL::sola.body: bSOL is SolBlaze's liquid staking token on the SPL Stake Pool program: deposited SOL is spread over about 680 validators and bSOL rises against SOL (1.3213 SOL per bSOL on 2026-10-18, about 4.5 % APR after a 5 % fee on rewards). The pool holds about 876k SOL.
BlazeStake Staked SOL (bSOL)::bSOL::sola.backing: SOL in the stake pool, delegated across ~680 validators
BlazeStake Staked SOL (bSOL)::bSOL::sola.yieldSource: SOL staking rewards, net of a 5 % fee
BlazeStake Staked SOL (bSOL)::bSOL::sola.redemption: instant SOL from the pool reserve (0.1 % fee, capped by the reserve), or unstake into a stake account (0.1 %, about one epoch), or sell
